contract: Predeclared by user: retain >=95% of originally correct size outputs, not 95% acceptance coverage. M=B24+sigma1.5/head_epoch03 and cachefix1 simple remain frozen. CPU numeric reuse only.
diagnostic_point_rule: First whole risk tie retaining ceil(target*good) outputs. GT is used only to describe ordering capacity, never to create or select a deployable policy. Reject-all risk is null; risk on empty acceptance is unavailable.
group_rule: One global risk threshold per method/role/component/constraint. Second scope is the max of group-specific first-retention thresholds, reused across all groups. Per-group capacity is diagnostic only, never domain/video routing.
comparisons: Frozen raw, score-only and simple; whole-tie complete curves; image-ordered label-free exact-count score control with tie bounds; keep FR, FA, ED, CR, accepted risk and all-frame coverage distinct.
continuity: At frozen and global diagnostic points, missing outputs unavailable, sequence/frame gaps reset runs. Report observed consecutive unavailable length and switches, not wall-clock outage duration. Direction assessed only on saved GT aspect>=1.2; all-frame online flag coverage separately.
decision: No new score/head/threshold training. Assess whether current rankings have a useful FA/CR tradeoff; do not claim an operational optimum without application risk requirement. No automatic promotion or follow-up training.
limitations: TRAIN in-sample; VAL previously used for development/calibration; no independent confirmation.
Correlated adjacent frames; empirical risks are descriptive, not mechanical safety or distribution-free guarantees.
